Mattress Protector: While not required, it’s highly recommended to protect your mattress from spills and dirt.
Pillows: Choose one that suits your sleep style. Adjustable-fill or side-sleeper pillows are great options.
Foundation: A firm, flat base like a platform bed, slatted frame (slats ≤3" apart), or Naturepedic’s wood foundation works well. Avoid placing the mattress directly on the floor.
